note: Precompiled DD2 co-op crash catalog. 'code' is an NTSTATUS hex (matched on the full 32-bit exit code) or a DD2gether symbol string matched in the launcher log. The popup shows '#' + the low 16 bits (e.g. 0xC0000139 -> #0139). report_default=false entries only report when a WER .dmp was also produced. suppress_if_clean_exit=true entries are dropped when the log shows an orderly quit.

default.title: Unexpected Game Crash
default.reason: Dragon's Dogma 2 closed unexpectedly for a reason not yet in the catalog. The report includes the exact code and the recent logs so it can be classified.
default.likely: Unknown - needs the attached logs/dump to diagnose.
default.action: Send the report so the exact code can be added to the catalog.

entries.title: Mod Loader Component Mismatch
entries.reason: A mod DLL asked Windows for a function that the installed version of another component does not provide, so the game was killed before it opened. This is a load-time version mismatch, not a gameplay fault.
entries.likely: A REFramework plugin (e.g. reframework-io-extend.dll) built for a different REFramework/game build; a stale or mixed modpack.
entries.action: Re-run DD2CoopSetup.exe to redeploy the matched modpack; if it persists, quarantine the offending plugin.

entries.title: Missing Mod Component
entries.reason: A required DLL was not found at launch, so the game could not start.
entries.likely: An incomplete modpack deploy; a deleted or blocked file (antivirus); REFramework dinput8.dll missing.
entries.action: Re-run DD2CoopSetup.exe to redeploy; check antivirus quarantine.

entries.title: Game Memory Fault
entries.reason: The game read or wrote memory it should not have and crashed. NOTE: DD2 also returns this code on a perfectly normal quit-to-desktop, so this is only reported when a real crash dump was produced and the logs do not show an orderly shutdown.
entries.likely: A mod interaction, a bad asset/pak, a GPU driver fault, or a genuine engine bug during play.
entries.action: Send the report with the crash dump; if it recurs at a specific action, note what you were doing.

entries.title: Disk or Paging Read Error
entries.reason: Windows could not read a page of the game's memory or files from disk.
entries.likely: A failing drive, a bad game file, or low memory/pagefile pressure.
entries.action: Verify the drive's health; re-run the installer to restore files if needed.

entries.title: Memory Guard Tripped
entries.reason: A security guard detected memory being overwritten and stopped the game at once (fail-fast).
entries.likely: A mod or asset corrupting memory; occasionally a driver.
entries.action: Send the report; this usually points at a specific mod or asset.

entries.title: Memory Heap Corruption
entries.reason: The game's memory allocator detected corruption and aborted.
entries.likely: A misbehaving mod/plugin writing out of bounds.
entries.action: Send the report with the dump; likely a specific plugin.

entries.title: Illegal Instruction
entries.reason: The CPU hit an instruction it could not execute and the game crashed.
entries.likely: Corrupted code/asset, overclock instability, or a bad patch pak.
entries.action: Send the report; re-run the installer to restore clean files.

entries.title: Stack Overflow
entries.reason: The game recursed too deeply and ran out of stack space.
entries.likely: A mod script loop or a pathological game state.
entries.action: Send the report; note what was happening in-game.

entries.title: Co-op Launcher Crash (DD2gether)
entries.reason: The DD2gether launcher (a .NET app) hit an unhandled exception and closed.
entries.likely: A launcher bug, a bad save-store state, or a Steam/network fault during setup.
entries.action: Send the report with the launcher log; try DD2CoopSetup.exe --repair if hosting was involved.

entries.title: Game Terminated
entries.reason: The process was terminated (e.g. closed from Task Manager). Not a crash.
entries.likely: User or system ended the process.

entries.match_log: did not confirm the private campaign|did not confirm private campaign startup
entries.title: Co-op Save Handshake Timeout
entries.reason: Hosting got stuck on 'Preparing campaign...' and timed out because the launcher and the in-game mod could not hand the save back and forth. This is the two-store split, not a game crash.
entries.likely: The DD2gether save folder is not shared with the game folder (split store), or a stuck prior session.
entries.action: Close the game and run DD2CoopSetup.exe --repair (re-links the save folder and clears the stuck session), then host again.
